propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist -n 3 --dist worksteal because the per-item WARNING log line is captured but the pass-summary INFO line is not
the reconciler entrypoint in-process sets the rebar_reconciler root logger to WARNING level and does not restore it, leaking to later tests in the same worker
caplog.at_level(logging.INFO) without a logger argument cannot rescue INFO-level assertions because it only raises the ROOT logger's level, not intermediate loggers like rebar_reconciler
the existing caplog containment guard _rebar_log_propagation_guard covers only the rebar root logger but not its sibling rebar_reconciler root, leaving reconciler-side assertions unprotected
generalizing the guard from a single scalar REBAR_LOGGER_NAME to a tuple SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES containing both rebar and rebar_reconciler roots makes all log assertions order-independent
the confirm_store is None path is not the mechanism because the per-item declining line only exists when confirm_store is non-None, proving the capture reached that code path
